dashboard.label: Executive summary
dashboard.description: The fleet's vulnerability position on one page, in the order the questions get asked: what is already being exploited, what of that can be reached, how much is open, what we chose to carry, and how far to trust the figures.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_feedstate_lookup | search _key=current | where isnotnull(generation) AND isnotnull(imported_at) | stats count AS feeds, max(imported_at) AS imported_at | eval feed_at = if(feeds = 0, "never", strftime(imported_at, "%Y-%m-%d")), feed_days = if(feeds = 0, "0", tostring(round((now() - imported_at) / 86400, 1))), feed_stale = if(feeds > 0 AND (now() - imported_at) / 86400 > 30, 1, 0), feed_cls = case(feeds = 0, "rk-exec-alarm", (now() - imported_at) / 86400 > 30, "rk-exec-alarm", (now() - imported_at) / 86400 > 7, "rk-exec-warned", 1=1, "rk-exec-calm")

| `riskability_hosts_seen` | lookup riskability_exposure_hoststate_lookup hostname OUTPUT assessed_at | stats count AS hosts, sum(eval(if(isnull(assessed_at), 1, 0))) AS unmeasured | fillnull value=0 unmeasured | eval unm_cls = if(unmeasured > 0, "rk-exec-warned", "rk-exec-plain")

| inputlookup riskability_openstate_host_lookup | stats count AS rk_rows, max(rolled_at) AS rolled | eval rolled_label = if(isnull(rolled), "never", strftime(rolled, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")), rolled_mins = if(isnull(rolled), 99999, round((now() - rolled) / 60))

index=`riskability_index_findings` sourcetype=riskability:findings record_type="match_receipt" earliest=0 latest=+10y _index_earliest=`riskability_stuck_window` _index_latest=now | stats max(match_run) AS match_run, sum(findings_produced) AS findings_produced BY hostname | where findings_produced > 0 | lookup riskability_matchstate_lookup hostname OUTPUT folded_run | eval acknowledged = if(isnotnull(folded_run) AND abs(tonumber(folded_run) - match_run) < 300, 1, 0) | where acknowledged == 0 | stats count AS stale

| inputlookup riskability_openstate_host_lookup | stats count AS hosts_open, sum(findings) AS open_findings, sum(accepted) AS accepted | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_openstate_cve_lookup | stats count AS open_cves] | appendcols [| inputlookup riskability_openstate_dim_lookup | where dim="severity" | stats sum(findings) AS dim_total] | fillnull value=0 hosts_open open_findings accepted open_cves | eval rollups_agree = if(isnull(dim_total) OR dim_total = open_findings, 1, 0)

| `riskability_reachability_for("*", "*")` | eval rk_kev_reach = if(reach_rank >= 2 AND is_kev = 1, 1, 0), rk_unknown = if(reach_rank < 0, 1, 0) | stats count AS findings, sum(rk_kev_reach) AS kev_reach_findings, dc(eval(if(rk_kev_reach = 1, hostname, null()))) AS kev_reach_hosts, sum(rk_unknown) AS unassessed_findings, dc(eval(if(rk_unknown = 1, hostname, null()))) AS unassessed_hosts | fillnull value=0 findings kev_reach_findings kev_reach_hosts unassessed_findings unassessed_hosts
| `riskability_accepted_findings` | eval rk_kev = if(isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added!="", cve_id, null()) | stats count AS rk_n, dc(rk_kev) AS accepted_kev | fillnull value=0 accepted_kev

| `riskability_exceptions_now` | stats count AS exc_rows, sum(eval(if(exc_state="active" AND expires_at!="" AND tonumber(expires_at) < relative_time(now(), "+14d"), 1, 0))) AS due_14d, sum(eval(if(exc_state="expired", 1, 0))) AS lapsed | fillnull value=0 due_14d lapsed

| inputlookup riskability_openstate_dim_lookup | where dim="severity" | stats count AS rk_rows, max(eval(if(lower(value)="critical", age_med, null()))) AS crit_days, max(eval(if(lower(value)="high", age_med, null()))) AS high_days, max(eval(if(lower(value)="critical", findings, null()))) AS crit_n, max(eval(if(lower(value)="high", findings, null()))) AS high_n | fillnull value=0 crit_n high_n | eval crit_days = if(isnull(crit_days), "none open", tostring(round(crit_days))), high_days = if(isnull(high_days), "none open", tostring(round(high_days)))

| inputlookup riskability_hostcadence_lookup | eval is_late = if(tonumber(learned) = 1 AND tonumber(late) = 1, 1, 0) | eval is_on = if(tonumber(learned) = 1 AND tonumber(late) != 1, 1, 0) | eval is_new = if(isnull(learned) OR tonumber(learned) != 1, 1, 0) | stats sum(is_late) AS late, sum(is_on) AS on_schedule, sum(is_new) AS unlearned, count AS total | fillnull value=0 late on_schedule unlearned total | eval late_cls = if(late > 0, "rk-exec-alarm", "rk-exec-calm")

| inputlookup riskability_openstate_cve_lookup | where isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added!="" | eval overdue = if(isnotnull(kev_due) AND kev_due!="" AND strptime(kev_due, "%Y-%m-%d") < now(), 1, 0) | stats count AS kev_cves, sum(overdue) AS kev_overdue | fillnull value=0 kev_overdue

div.b: No vulnerability feed has been imported, so nothing on this page can be assessed.
div.span: A zero here is no data, not no risk. An administrator imports the bundle on Administration, Feed administration.

div.b: A feed was imported on $feed_at$ but no system has reported its software inventory yet.
div.span: There is nothing to compare it against.

div.b: The hourly roll-up has not written yet, so the tiles read zero while the finding state holds $live_open$ open findings.
div.span: The numbers arrive within the hour. If they do not, the pipeline has stopped and Start here reports which job.

div.b: Nothing is open, confirmed against the finding state and not only against the roll-up.
div.span: Accepted risks, if any, are counted in their own tile.

div.b: Some hosts are matched but not folded in.
div.span: Open counts are stale-high for those hosts and closing is withheld until the fold completes: risk is over-reported, never under-reported. Usually clears within the hour.

div.b: These counts are behind the finding state.
div.span: Every total on this page comes from an hourly roll-up, last written $rollup_at$, and that is more than an hour ago.

div.b: The breakdown and the total come from two hourly roll-ups that did not run together.
div.span: Quote the total; the severity chart will agree within the hour.

div.b: Every number here is measured against a feed imported $feed_at$, $feed_days$ days ago.
div.span: Vulnerabilities published since then are invisible. A falling count on an ageing feed is blindness, not improvement.

html.div: Figures as of $rollup_at$, from the hourly roll-up. Feed imported $feed_at$. Accepted risks are excluded from every count except their own tile. Every zero on this page is explained by the panel beside it or a banner above it.

div.button: Print or save as PDF (A4 landscape)
div.p: Three landscape sheets: the figures, the two pictures, what changed and what to do. Choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog for a file. Safari ignores the page's own orientation, so pick landscape there. Splunk's own Export to PDF leaves the charts out. Nobody can schedule this; it is this page, printed by your browser.

div.span: Median, counted from when Riskability first saw the finding, not from when the vulnerability was published. It means something only once collection has run longer than the fixes it is measuring.

panel.title: What to do first: open findings by whether they can be reached and how likely they are to be exploited

search.query: | `riskability_reachability_for("*", "*")` | stats count AS findings BY exploit_class, reach_class, tier | fields exploit_class, reach_class, findings, tier

viz.option: Nothing to place. Either there are no open findings, or the exposure snapshot has not run yet. A system that was never checked is unknown risk, not low risk.

div.b: Colour is urgency, not count.
div.span: KEV means on CISA's list of vulnerabilities attackers are already using. EPSS is the published likelihood of exploitation. Rows say whether the copy on our system answers the network; the dashed row is systems we could not check, which is unknown risk, not low risk.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_openstate_dim_lookup | where dim="severity" | eval ord = case(lower(value)="critical", 1, lower(value)="high", 2, in(lower(value), "medium", "moderate"), 3, lower(value)="low", 4, 1=1, 5) | sort 0 ord | table value, findings

viz.option: No open findings. With no feed imported the app cannot assess anything yet, which is not a clean fleet. Check the Feed administration page.

div.b: Slices add up to the open findings figure above, accepted risks excluded.
div.span: Unrated means the feed carried no severity for it, which is not the same as low.

panel.title: Movement in the last 30 days, by week

search.query: | `riskability_findings_now` | eval rk_opened = if(status="open" AND coalesce(accepted, "0")!="1" AND first_seen >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d"), 1, 0) | eval rk_closed = if(in(status, "mitigated", "removed", "unknown") AND isnotnull(closed_at) AND closed_at >= relative_time(now(), "-30d@d"), 1, 0) | where rk_opened = 1 OR rk_closed = 1 | eval rk_wk = relative_time(if(rk_closed = 1, closed_at, first_seen), "@w1") | eval week = strftime(rk_wk, "%d %b") | eval series = if(rk_closed = 1, status, "open") | stats dc(finding_key) AS findings, min(rk_wk) AS rk_order BY week, series | sort 0 rk_order | table week, series, findings

viz.option: No findings recorded yet. This chart fills in as scans accumulate.

div.b: Weeks start on Monday. Only a green bar, mitigated, is evidence of a fix.
div.span: Open is first seen that week and still open; mitigated is a version change observed at the same path; removed and unknown stopped being reported without that evidence. Bars cluster on scan and feed import times. Thirty days because closed findings are archived after thirty days, so a longer window would understate fixes.

panel.title: The five things to fix first

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_openstate_cve_lookup | where isnotnull(kev_added) AND kev_added!="" | sort 50000 - hosts | head 5 | eval packages = mvjoin(packages, ", ") | eval fix_by = if(isnull(kev_due) OR kev_due="", "not stated", kev_due) | eval title = case(isnull(title) OR title="", "No description in the feed for this one.", len(title) > 220, substr(title, 1, 217) . "...", 1=1, title) | table title, cve_id, hosts, packages, fix_by | rename title AS "What it is", cve_id AS "Vulnerability", hosts AS "Systems", packages AS "Packages", fix_by AS "Fix-by date"

div.b: The same known-exploited vulnerabilities as Fleet overview's table, ordered by how many systems carry them.
div.span: $kev_overdue$ of the $kev_cves$ listed are past the fix-by date the US government set for its own agencies. What it is is the shortest advisory description the roll-up already picks.

div.b: No known-exploited vulnerabilities matched.
div.span: This reflects the KEV catalogue in the imported bundle; if KEV was unreachable when the bundle was built, it is blank for that reason, and the tile above is grey rather than green for the same reason.

div.b: How to read this page.
div.span: Accepted risks are excluded from every count except their own tile; no open findings plus many accepted ones is not a clean fleet. A zero is no data until the banners above are clear. Could not be checked means unknown, not safe. Every figure comes from the same hourly roll-ups the other pages read, so a number here always matches the page it links to.

html.div: Riskability executive summary. Figures as of $rollup_at$ from the hourly roll-up; feed imported $feed_at$; $f_total$ systems known, $f_late$ gone quiet. Accepted risks excluded. Could not be checked means unknown, not safe. Printed .
